column3: Anti-clickjacking header: API returns JSON, nothing frameable.
CSP header not set: meaningless on JSON responses (and on 401/404 bodies).
Permissions-Policy not set: only matters for rendered documents.
Spectre site-isolation headers (COOP/CORP): document-level, not relevant to a JSON API.
Cookie without HttpOnly: only cookie seen is the ALB stickiness cookie (AWSALB), set by AWS, not ours.
Cookie without Secure: same AWSALB cookie, AWS-managed.
Cookie without SameSite: same AWSALB cookie, AWS-managed.
